summary: City page (moved) + its Set Your Sites engine read: $35/night all sites, reservable online (was FCFS-only), 14-night max, 30/50 A electric only (no water/sewer at sites), 22 RV units (page says 18 pads), Mar-Dec season (now manual), dump + bathhouse/showers. Lakeview recommended down to not waterfront (pads ~150-250 m from either lake across road/shelterbelt/ball fields).
flags: WATERFRONT (re-audit, recommend lakeview -> not waterfront): the pads could not be picked out individually; the likeliest place (unshaded gravel, matching 'no shaded sites') is the gravel lot at the pin ~45.7716,-99.6344, west of the treed park block; anywhere in the park block is at least ~150 m from either lake. The west lake's high-water edge is ~150-180 m west across rows of planted trees (a shelterbelt), County Road 3 and grass; the east lake is ~250 m east beyond the running track, ball fields and park buildings. No source (city page, engine, camper reviews) says the lake is seen from the sites; Google/RV Life reviews say only 'no shaded sites'. Replacement evidence: 'Esri World_Imagery 2026-11-21 at 45.7716,-99.6344: gravel RV lot west of the city park block; west lake ~160 m beyond planted tree rows and County Road 3, east lake ~250 m beyond the track and ball fields -> not waterfront'.
